messages:
Aisha: Hey team, quick ask while Im finalizing my leave: Im the hiring lead for two open SWE roles. Whats the preferred way to hand off interview loops and who signs off on offer packets while Im out? Also any reminders about FMLA/state disability docs I should file before day one of leave?
Tom: Congrats Aisha! For hiring: create a short "interview handoff" doc in the hiring folder, tag the interviewers, and set a deputy reviewer. Usually the manager + recruiting partner can approve offers if the hiring lead is on leave. If its a compensation exception, we still need People Ops sign-off.
Aisha: Great — want to avoid blocking candidates. Is there a simple template I should use for the handoff doc?
Renee: Ill drop a template in the thread. Key things: candidate stage, score summary, suggested comp band, key concerns, proposed start date, and list of interviewers to contact. Also add links to take-home assignments or code review notes.
Renee: Template snippet:
```
Candidate: <name>
Stage: onsites scheduled / final debrief / offer recommended
Scores: 
- System design: 4/5
- Coding: 3/5
Proposed comp: $XXXk + equity band
Notes: candidate availability, visa needs, start date target
Deputy: <peer name> (contact info)
```
Tom: For approvals: recruiting partner can push offers up to the band. Anything above band or sign-on needs People Ops + Finance approval. Tag @Benefits for comp/relocation questions.
Benefits: Hi Aisha  for FMLA/short-term disability: submit the company's leave request form and attach your physicians certification before your leave start date to ensure payments and job protection. For state disability (if applicable) youll also need to file the state portal; we can pre-fill employer portion.
Aisha: Do I need to elect COBRA or anything immediate? Im planning to keep benefits but want to understand payroll deductions while on paid leave vs unpaid.
Benefits: If you remain on paid leave, benefits stay active and payroll deductions continue as usual. If you go unpaid beyond company-paid leave, well send COBRA enrollment info. We can run a one-page net-pay estimation if that helps.
Aisha: Yes please — can someone send an estimate for my planned 8-week leave (6 weeks company-paid, then 2 unpaid)?
people-ops-bot: Ticket HR-LEAVE-912 created for Aisha; People Ops will run a pay & benefits estimate and reply in 2 business days.
Renee: Also — note re interview panels: ask recruiters to move any candidate who is ready to hire to a 72-hour accelerated decision window if youd prefer they wait for you. Otherwise appoint a backup decision maker.
Tom: Practical: add calendar oof with "Hiring coverage: backup Tom" and put the handoff doc link in the OOO message so recruiters and candidates can see it.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. One last question: can I nominate someone to be the emergency contact for HR forms while on leave? I want them to be able to sign certain administrative things.
Benefits: You can designate an authorized rep for administrative approvals (not legally binding docs) by filling the Authorization form: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/forms/authorization. For anything that changes benefits or pay we require the employees written consent.
Aisha: Awesome. Ill upload the docs and post the handoff doc by EOD today. Appreciate the help! :heart:
